raw_request: Unify dsh-tui under the new AppSDK governance surface and resume development from the reset state.
understood_objective: Retire incompatible legacy governance state, bind dsh-tui's real source and module maps to the new AppSDK governance surface, and continue development only after official verification.
acceptance_criteria: The reset governance surface is bound to dsh-tui without deleting business source or protected history.
The project resource, function, mainline, module, and verification maps are bound to real dsh-tui sources and pass AppSDK verification.
Development resumes only after the new governance surface is verified; lifecycle records are produced only by the official AppSDK flow.
non_goals: Change protected history or business source as part of governance reset.
assumptions: dsh-tui is the current project root.
The official AppSDK binary is the governance engine.
